description: Na₂(ReSe₂)₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six Se atoms. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.94-3.52 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight Se atoms. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 3.08-3.47 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to six Se atoms. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 3.04-3.54 Å. There are three inequivalent Re sites. In the first Re site, Re is bonded to five Se atoms to form distorted edge-sharing ReSe₅ square pyramids. There are a spread of Re-Se bond distances ranging from 2.53-2.58 Å. In the second Re site, Re is bonded to five Se atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ReSe₅ square pyramids. There are a spread of Re-Se bond distances ranging from 2.54-2.67 Å. In the third Re site, Re is bonded to five Se atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ReSe₅ square pyramids. There are a spread of Re-Se bond distances ranging from 2.53-2.69 Å. There are six inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na and three Re atoms. In the second Se site, Se is bonded to two equivalent Na and three Re atoms to form distorted SeNa₂Re₃ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent SeNa₃Re₂ trigonal bipyramids and edges with two SeNa₂Re₃ trigonal bipyramids. In the third Se site, Se is bonded in a distorted pentagonal planar geometry to two Na and three Re atoms. In the fourth Se site, Se is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three Na and three Re atoms. In the fifth Se site, Se is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Re, and one Se atom. The Se-Se bond length is 2.43 Å. In the sixth Se site, Se is bonded to three Na and two Re atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing SeNa₃Re₂ trigonal bipyramids.
